name: United Kingdom
officialName: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

flag.description: The Union Jack: a blue field with the red cross of St George edged in white, over the white diagonal cross of St Andrew combined with the offset red diagonal cross of St Patrick.
flag.symbolism: It combines the crosses of the patron saints of England (St George), Scotland (St Andrew) and Ireland (St Patrick).

hook: Three saints' crosses layered on blue fill the whole flag: if the Union Jack is only a small corner of a blue flag with stars, think Australia, New Zealand or Tuvalu instead.
trivia: Wales is not represented on the flag because it was already united with England when the first Union Flag was created in 1606.
The flag is not symmetrical: correctly flown, the broader white diagonal is above the red one on the half nearest the flagpole.
